anna: quick heads-up: p99 up ~18% on llama3-13b after yesterday's kernel-selector change. baseline ~120ms -> now ~142ms on our perf hosts.
perf-bot: ALERT: model=llama3-13b p99_latency +18% (120 -> 142 ms) — tagging #eng-runtime :rotating_light:
mike: can you paste the repro/log snippet?
anna: pasted nvprof slice + runtime logs:
```
[2026-03-17T22:03:11Z] kernel_selector: seq_bin=2 assigned kernel=matmul_v1 (expected matmul_v0)
[2026-03-17T22:03:11Z] kv_cache: write_offset mismatch: 4096 vs 4096 (chatpad-pad=8)
GPU: matmul_v1 avg=1.8us, matmul_v0 avg=1.2us
```
josh: that seq_bin line smells like an off-by-one in bin assignment. current code clamps with <= then bin_index = ceil(len / bin_size) - 1; edge case when len%bin_size==0 will flip to next bin. :face_with_monocle:
sophia: fwiw chat template change in PR#482 disabled trimming so chatpad adds 8 tokens now. effective_seq jumps into next bin and kv write aligns weirdly -> kernel fallback. seen similar with mixtral small-head configs.
mike: quick repro command to run locally:
```
./scripts/repro_perf.sh --model llama3-13b --seq 512 --chatpad 8 --profile nvprof
```
anna: ran locally, nvprof shows path switch exactly at seq=512. added debug prints:
```
# kernel selector snippet
if seq % bin_size == 0:
  bin = seq // bin_size  # current code
# should be:
  bin = max(0, seq//bin_size - 1)
```
josh: agree. propose patch: (1) fix bin math, (2) compute effective_seq = seq - chatpad when picking kernel, (3) add unit test covering seq in {511,512,513}.
sophia: also flagging RMSNorm->SiLU layout change from recent perf PR — we should validate that memory stride didn't push kernel heuristics to choose matmul_v1 for alignment reasons. but bin fix is low-risk and fast rollback if needed.
mike: i'll open a canary PR with both fixes + a metric hook for p99. will roll to dedicated pool-B first.
infra-bot: deploy-triggered: canary start on poolB at 4201201300 by mike
anna: thanks all. follow-ups: verify kv cache offsets (josh), check RMSNorm mem-layout tests (sophia), monitor p99 in datadog (mike). also opened issue #674 for rope_theta default experiments on small-head mixes (mixtral/qwen) — separate.
josh: i'll draft the regression postmortem once canary stabilizes and assign to anna/mike.
mike: ack, will post perf graphs in this thread when available. :thumbsup:
